name: Reports & Financial Insights
notes: Adds multi-month and custom-date financial insights for income, actual spending, net cash flow, category distribution, account-balance history, planned-versus-actual budgets, Utility Bills, Gym activity, recurring-expense changes, Savings progress, project profitability, year-to-date comparison, CSV export, and print-ready PDF output while preserving Finance Schema 12, Cloud Schema V2, Ledger Version 1, and Budget Version 1.
